subject: E-5181: cannot write data directory on macOS
body:
Before writing in I attempted closing every other program; same error afterwards.

Tomas Vik -- Harbour Freight. Appreciate any hints.

Hi, I'm using CourierOS 3.5.8 on macOS 15.3. Since Monday, each time I open the app, I get "E-5181:
cannot write to data directory".

There is less than a gigabyte free on the system drive. Other programs have began complaining
about space as well.
